This Quarto notebook is the canonical executable source for
`scripts/run_16s_exploratory_differential_abundance.qmd`. It is optional, and
its output is exploratory by construction. With one membrane per condition
there is no biological replication for a condition contrast, so any per-ASV
difference is a property of these two systems. ALDEx2 is used because it works
on unrarefied counts and treats the data as compositional. Every output file
and column carries the exploratory label so it cannot be quoted later as a
confirmatory result.

```sh
bash scripts/run_qmd.sh scripts/run_16s_exploratory_differential_abundance.qmd [phyloseq_dir] [output_dir]
```

Automatic execution during rendering is disabled because this workflow writes
project outputs.

```{r}
#| label: run-16s-exploratory-differential-abundance
#| echo: true
abort <- function(...) stop(sprintf(...), call. = FALSE)

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
phyloseq_dir <- if (length(args) >= 1L) args[[1L]] else Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_PHYLOSEQ_DIR")
output_dir <- if (length(args) >= 2L) args[[2L]] else Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_DA_DIR")
if (!nzchar(phyloseq_dir) || !nzchar(output_dir)) {
  abort("Provide phyloseq_dir and output_dir, or source config/16s_analysis_paths.sh first.")
}
if (!requireNamespace("phyloseq", quietly = TRUE)) abort("Package phyloseq is required.")
if (!requireNamespace("ALDEx2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  cat("ALDEx2 is not installed. This optional step is skipped by design.\n")
  cat("Install with BiocManager::install(\"ALDEx2\") only if the exploratory view is wanted.\n")
  quit(save = "no", status = 0)
}
set.seed(20260901L)
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

physeq <- readRDS(file.path(phyloseq_dir, "16s_phyloseq.rds"))
counts <- as(phyloseq::otu_table(physeq), "matrix")
if (phyloseq::taxa_are_rows(physeq)) counts <- t(counts)
design <- as.data.frame(as(phyloseq::sample_data(physeq), "data.frame"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
design <- design[rownames(counts), , drop = FALSE]
taxonomy <- as.data.frame(as(phyloseq::tax_table(physeq), "matrix"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# A prevalence filter keeps the CLR from being dominated by singletons. It is a
# stated preprocessing choice, not a hidden default.
min_count <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_DA_MIN_COUNT", "10"))
min_samples <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_DA_MIN_SAMPLES", "3"))
keep <- colSums(counts >= 1) >= min_samples & colSums(counts) >= min_count
cat(sprintf("Testing %d of %d ASVs after the prevalence filter.\n", sum(keep), ncol(counts)))

matrix_for_aldex <- t(counts[, keep, drop = FALSE])
condition <- as.character(design$condition)

result <- ALDEx2::aldex(
  reads = as.data.frame(matrix_for_aldex),
  conditions = condition,
  mc.samples = as.integer(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_DA_MC_SAMPLES", "128")),
  test = "t",
  effect = TRUE,
  denom = "all"
)

result$asv_id <- rownames(result)
ranks <- intersect(c("Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus"), colnames(taxonomy))
for (rank in ranks) {
  result[[tolower(rank)]] <- taxonomy[result$asv_id, rank]
}
result$evidence_class <- "exploratory_only"
result$experimental_unit_caveat <- "one membrane per condition; not a replicated treatment contrast"
result <- result[order(result$wi.eBH, -abs(result$effect)), ]
result <- result[, c("asv_id", tolower(ranks), setdiff(colnames(result),
                     c("asv_id", tolower(ranks))))]

output_path <- file.path(output_dir, "16s_exploratory_differential_abundance.tsv")
write.table(result, output_path, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "")

summary_table <- data.frame(
  quantity = c("asvs_tested", "asvs_with_welch_ebh_below_0.05",
               "asvs_with_absolute_effect_above_1", "asvs_meeting_both"),
  value = c(
    nrow(result),
    sum(result$we.eBH < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(abs(result$effect) > 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(result$we.eBH < 0.05 & abs(result$effect) > 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(summary_table, file.path(output_dir, "16s_exploratory_da_summary.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

print(summary_table)
cat(sprintf("\nWrote exploratory results to %s\n", output_path))
cat("These results may support a supplementary observation. They may not be written\n")
cat("as a treatment effect, and they may not be used to select features for other analyses.\n")
```
